use default
use System.Text.StringBuilder

struct BT is
    digits: string

    init(digits: string) is
        self.digits = digits
    si

    to_string() -> string => digits
si

digit_value(c: char) -> int =>
    case c
    when '+' then 1
    when '-' then -1
    else 0
    esac

digit_char(v: int) -> char =>
    if v == 1 then '+' elif v == -1 then '-' else '0' fi

balanced(n: bigint) -> BT is
    let three = 3n
    let chars = LIST()
    let remaining mut = n
    let more mut = true

    while more do
        let r mut = cast int(remaining % three)
        if r < 0 then r = r + 3 fi
        if r == 2 then r = -1 fi

        chars.add(digit_char(r))
        remaining = (remaining - bigint(r)) / three
        more = remaining !~ 0n
    od

    chars.reverse()
    BT(chars |> map(c => "{c}") |> join(""))
si

value(a: BT) -> bigint is
    let three = 3n
    let total mut = 0n

    for c in a.digits do
        total = total * three + bigint(digit_value(c))
    od

    total
si

-(a: BT) -> BT is
    let flipped = StringBuilder()

    for c in a.digits do
        flipped.append(digit_char(-digit_value(c)))
    od

    BT(flipped.to_string())
si

+(a: BT, b: BT) -> BT is
    let chars = LIST()
    let carry mut = 0
    let i mut = a.digits.length - 1
    let j mut = b.digits.length - 1

    while i >= 0 \/ j >= 0 \/ carry != 0 do
        let sum mut = carry

        if i >= 0 then
            sum = sum + digit_value(a.digits[i])
            i = i - 1
        fi

        if j >= 0 then
            sum = sum + digit_value(b.digits[j])
            j = j - 1
        fi

        let d mut = sum % 3
        if d < 0 then d = d + 3 fi
        if d == 2 then d = -1 fi

        carry = (sum - d) / 3
        chars.add(digit_char(d))
    od

    while chars.count > 1 /\ chars[chars.count - 1] == '0' do
        chars.remove_at(chars.count - 1)
    od

    chars.reverse()
    BT(chars |> map(c => "{c}") |> join(""))
si

-(a: BT, b: BT) -> BT => a + -b

<<(a: BT, places: int) -> BT is
    let zeroes = StringBuilder()

    for _ in 1::places do
        zeroes.append('0')
    od

    BT("{a.digits}{zeroes}")
si

*(a: BT, b: BT) -> BT is
    let product mut = BT("0")

    for i in 0..a.digits.length do
        let d = digit_value(a.digits[a.digits.length - 1 - i])

        if d != 0 then
            let term = b << i

            product = product + if d == 1 then term else -term fi
        fi
    od

    product
si

let b = balanced(bigint(-436))
